premises: Mn-free alloys (CrCoNi, CrFeCoNi) have a lower-energy hcp phase relative to fcc, enabling fcc-to-hcp transformation
Mn in CrMnFeCoNi introduces magnetic frustration that eliminates the fcc-hcp energy difference, suppressing transformation
The fcc-to-hcp transformation in Mn-free alloys is triggered by dislocation slip and interaction with internal boundaries
This transformation enhances work hardening and strength without loss of ductility
In the quinary alloy, deformation is dominated by dislocation slip and nanotwinning instead of transformation
